scenes.text: In 1948, a woman signed a hotel register under a name that did not exist.
scenes.art_prompt: an open hotel register on a wooden desk, fountain pen, warm lamp light, storybook

scenes.text: She paid for three nights in advance and asked not to be disturbed.
scenes.art_prompt: a hotel key on a counter with a small brass tag, dim lobby, storybook

scenes.text: On the fourth morning the room was found tidy, the bed untouched. She was gone.
scenes.art_prompt: a neat empty hotel room with an unopened suitcase, soft daylight, storybook

scenes.text: Decades later, the same name appeared in four more registers, in four other cities.
scenes.art_prompt: four old registers stacked on an archive table, dust in a single beam, storybook

scenes.text:
Same handwriting every time. Same three nights.
Each signature dated the day after the guest vanished.
scenes.art_prompt: a close view of a signed page, the date slightly darker than the name, storybook

scenes.text: Follow Unsolved Archive for the next file.
scenes.art_prompt: an empty hotel corridor at night, one door ajar, final wide shot, storybook
